description: True delta from the venue's taker buy volume (6th field of each bar). Bar 0: volume 100, buy 75, sell 25, delta_pct (75 - 25) / 100 * 100 = 50. Bar 1: volume 40, buy 10, sell 40 - 10 = 30, delta 10 - 30 = -20, delta_pct -20 / 40 * 100 = -50. No intrabars are used, so intrabar_count is 0 and coverage is 100.
